en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a wide, mostly empty town market square with a central fountain and a street lamp in the foreground. Around the square stand 2–3‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs and shop signs in German on their facades. A church tower with a clock rises behind the row of houses slightly left of center, while a building on the right with a small tower and sign houses a hotel and restaurant. A lone person walks across the square, and a horse‑drawn covered wagon stands on the right edge. At the top left is a caption identifying the place as 'Radeburg. Markt,'.
